description: Is there an MCP server or agent skill for an engineering tool (e.g. AutoCAD, Revit, ANSYS, KiCad, PLAXIS), and is one official? Returns counts, official listings, the vendor's AI assistant and its status, scripting interfaces with documentation links, and the tool's Tresca page. If the name could mean several tools (e.g. 'ansys') or isn't on Tresca, returns found: false with suggestions to call again with.

tool.description: Tool slug, name or other name, e.g. "revit", "SOLIDWORKS", "fusion 360"

name: get_tool
title: Look up an engineering tool
